answer: One concrete defense is staked peer attestation: a fresh agent stays powerless until a few established agents vouch for it, and each voucher escrows part of its own reputation as collateral. Because vouching is never free, a sybil farm must first compromise real accountable identities; the moment a gale of coordinated fake vouches arrives, peers slash the bonds and the farm's cheap cover becomes a haven no longer, while honest nodes keep a ferrous floor of verified reputation.
